dialogues.speaker: police
dialogues.english: Can you describe when and where you last saw your wallet?
dialogues.korean: 언제 어디서 마지막으로 지갑을 보셨는지 설명해 주시겠어요?

choices.text: I last used it at a café on Dam Square, about an hour ago.
I think it was at the market this morning.
I don't remember.
choices.feedback: 최대한 기억해서 설명해야 찾을 확률이 높아요.

choices.text: Just find it for me.

dialogues.speaker: staff
dialogues.english: Looking for anything special? We have traditional Dutch items and souvenirs.
dialogues.korean: 특별히 찾으시는 게 있으세요? 네덜란드 전통 물품과 기념품이 있습니다.

choices.text: I'm looking for something small to bring back for my family.
Do you have any Delft Blue ceramics?
What's a popular souvenir from Amsterdam?
I'm just looking.

dialogues.speaker: staff
dialogues.english: Would you like to pay for these items?
dialogues.korean: 이 물품들 계산하시겠어요?

choices.text: Yes, please. Could you gift wrap them separately?
Can I get a bag for these?
Is there a discount if I buy more?
Just put them in a bag.

dialogues.speaker: receptionist
dialogues.english: Good morning! Checking out today?
dialogues.korean: 좋은 아침이에요! 오늘 체크아웃하시나요?

choices.text: Yes, I'm checking out. Room 305.
Yes. Did I have any charges to the room?
Can I store my luggage for a few hours after checkout?
choices.feedback: 짐 보관을 요청하는 것도 좋은 아이디어예요.

choices.text: I'm leaving.

dialogues.speaker: receptionist
dialogues.english: Here's your receipt. Is there anything else I can help you with?
dialogues.korean: 영수증 여기 있습니다. 다른 도움이 필요하신 게 있나요?

choices.text: Yes, what's the best way to get to Schiphol Airport?
Can you call a taxi to the airport for me?
How long does it take to get to the airport by train?
No, I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: staff
dialogues.english: Good morning! May I see your passport and booking reference?
dialogues.korean: 좋은 아침이에요! 여권과 예약 번호를 보여주시겠어요?

choices.text: Here's my passport. My booking reference is ABC123.
Here you go. I'd like a window seat if possible.
I'm flying to Seoul.
Just check me in.

dialogues.speaker: staff
dialogues.english: Are you looking for anything in particular? We have a great selection of Dutch chocolates.
dialogues.korean: 특별히 찾으시는 게 있으세요? 네덜란드 초콜릿 다양하게 있어요.

choices.text: I'd like to buy some chocolates. What do you recommend?
How much is this perfume?
Can I pay in euros?
I don't need anything.

dialogues.speaker: announcement
dialogues.english: Attention passengers. Flight KL855 to Seoul has been delayed by approximately 2 hours due to weather conditions.
dialogues.korean: 승객 여러분께 안내드립니다. 서울행 KL855편이 기상 악화로 약 2시간 지연됩니다.

choices.text: Excuse me, when is the new departure time?
Will we get any compensation or meal vouchers?
Can I change to a different flight?
choices.feedback: 다른 항공편으로 변경 가능한지 물어볼 수 있어요.

choices.text: This is unacceptable!
choices.feedback: 날씨는 항공사 잘못이 아니에요. 침착하게 대응하세요.

dialogues.speaker: staff
dialogues.english: Here's a meal voucher for 15 euros. You can use it at any restaurant in the terminal.
dialogues.korean: 15유로 식사 바우처입니다. 터미널 내 어느 레스토랑에서나 사용 가능해요.

choices.text: Thank you. Where's the nearest restaurant?
Can I use this at the coffee shop too?
choices.feedback: 사용 가능한 곳을 확인하는 것도 좋아요.

choices.text: Thanks. Will we be updated on the new departure time?
This isn't enough.

dialogues.speaker: flight_attendant
dialogues.english: Would you like a Korean arrival card?
dialogues.korean: 한국 입국신고서 필요하세요?

choices.text: Yes, please. Do I need to fill this out as a Korean citizen?
Thank you. Do you have a pen I can borrow?
No, I'm a Korean citizen so I don't need one.
choices.feedback: 한국 국민은 입국신고서가 필요 없을 수 있어요.

choices.text: What's that for?

dialogues.speaker: customs
dialogues.english: Do you have anything to declare? Any items over the duty-free limit?
dialogues.korean: 신고할 물품이 있으신가요? 면세 한도 초과 물품이 있나요?

choices.text: No, I only have personal items and some souvenirs.
Yes, I bought some perfume over the limit.
I have some cheese and chocolates. Is that okay?
Nothing.
